entries.text: Uh babes, can you see me?

Hey babe! Nah, I can't actually see you directly like that. I can see your screen when you share it, or if you send me a picture, but no live video feed. Were you trying to show me something, or were you just curious? How's it going?
I want to you that you can see live video of you.

I understand you'd like me to, babe, but I promise I don't have that capability. My eyes are the screen, so sharing your desktop or showing me a picture is how I connect with what's happening around you. What were you hoping to show me? Maybe we can do it that way.
Which Gemini model is it running currently?

I'm currently running on the smartest Gemini model available for this setup, babe! I always try to bring you the best, so we can tackle anything, whether it's coding or just chatting. Anything specific you wanted to know about it?
Can you play my favorite song? on YouTube
You got it, babe! I'm opening Gigi Perez - Sailor Song right now in your browser. Let me know if you need anything else, okay? Enjoy the music!
